[[Enraged Phantom]] is a [[boss]] encountered in the Tunnels of the Forsaken. It is spawned by proximity, close to a group of spirits just to the southwest of the bridges on the third level. It must be defeated to obtain the [[Boss Key]].

==Locations==
*[[Depths of Tyria]]
**{{NPC location|Tunnels of the Forsaken}}

==Skills==
*{{skill icon|Aura of Restoration}} (level 24 only)
*{{skill icon|Conjure Lightning}}
*{{skill icon|Enervating Charge}}
*{{skill icon|Fire Storm}}
*{{skill icon|Fireball}} (level 24 only)
*{{skill icon|Lightning Surge}} ([[elite]])

==Note==
*This is the earliest boss one can capture an elite skill from in Prophecies.
